_about: What travels in the posts of his Instagram inspo feed, read on 16 Nov 2026 for the re-run of Tue, Thu and Sat of the week of 16 Nov. Feed fallback: the Instagram inspo sheet could not be read (the Posts tab has no published, retrieved, headline, post url column); the patterns come from the feed the gather read (inspiration.lookalike_feed). Stale sheet: the gathered feed's newest row is 2026-11-11, more than 3 days before 2026-11-16; the patterns lean on older posts. The feed rows carry headlines and short summaries only, no slide text, so each card_flow is read from what the headline and summary say the post does.
